Fixed known bugs:
1. Fixed infinite recursion bug caused by repeated useCard reference when using "?! Mere?!"
2. Fixed issue where "ququ" cheat code couldn't target Ailan City District
3. Didn't find other bugs; actually fixed before launch, e.g., Ailan Worm (enemy) hitting itself with Mercy
New Mechanics:
1. Anyone who played yesterday's version knows there's a new charge ball in the status bar. Yes, charge balls are now fully implemented and usable!
Not-So-New Cards:
1. Current Generation (code: CurrentGeneration) – effects omitted for brevity
2. Thunder Strike (code: Thunder) – generates 2 Lightning Charge Balls
Believe there will be more bugs to fix in the future

Fixed known bugs:
1. Manifest wasn't bound, so the previous version couldn't actually show announcements. Fixed angrily.
2. Seems like that's all.
New Mechanics: Frost Charge Balls
I hope you haven't forgotten what Frost Charge Balls do, but I'll explain anyway:
[On Destruction] Gain a large amount of shield, reduce enemy Swiftness by 3
[End of Turn] Gain some shield
Not-So-New Cards:
No new cards this time. Don't you feel there are too few enemies? So this update focuses on enemy targets – meaning you still can't play with Frost Charge Balls 🤡
New Enemies / Balance Adjustments:
1. [Normal Enemy] Thunder Elemental Spirit: Has both Lightning Charge Balls and Charge mechanics, but being a normal enemy, its numbers limit its potential.
2. [Boss] Valencina: Valencina was pissed off when she heard she was kicked aside like a roadside trash, so she got several buffs:
I Valencina will no longer skip the first turn
II Valencina will now dodge
III Valencina's "Jie Lu" won't reduce this-turn strength when acceleration bullets are below 3
IV Valencina's Disposal: DOT, damage, and scaling increased
V Precognition Eye cap raised to 20; using Disposal will immediately set it to 10
3. [Boss] Rein: Hermes made him do it
I Player Panic now directly causes them to become Staggered
II In battle against Rein, player's Sinking strength won't go below 5
4. [Boss] No-Self Yoshide:
I No-Self Yoshide's own HP cap reduced
II No-Self Yoshide's damage reduced
III No-Self Yoshide's Stagger line adjusted to -0 2, , . ]
IV Yoshide gains 2 locked health; on trigger, HP cap and HP set to 0.2x outside HP
V No-Self Yoshide won't fail while having shield

Fixed known bugs/Adjustments:
1. Previously rushed to leave work, causing errors in the announcement section. Fixed now.
2. Forgot that Rein's small skills didn't apply Sinking, so now they do.
3. Fixed bug where No-Self Yoshide's recovered HP after locked health wasn't affected by Restrictions.
4. No-Self Yoshide's damage seemed a bit too high, flipping into negative, so restrictions were applied.
5. Frost Charge Balls now have a way to obtain! Calm Brain gives Concentration and Frost Charge Balls [code: CalmBrain].
6. New Charge Ball: Ion Charge Ball. On trigger (destruction) and turn start, gain extra Light (Is this still a Project Moon fan game? Where am I even?) Related cards:
 I Rainbow [code: rainbow] (3): Consumption – gain 1 Lightning, 1 Frost, and 1 Ion Charge Ball in sequence
 II Charge [code: charge] (1): Effect depends on Charge strength: <=3: gain lots of Charge stacks and consume all; 4-5: gain 2 Energy, some Charge stacks and consume all; >6: gain 1 Ion Charge Ball
7. No-Self Yoshide changes:
 I No-Self Yoshide will... also... damage reduced
 II No-Self Yoshide over 300 will directly use..., also...
8. Valencina adjustments:
 I If Valencina has Precognition Eye >6 when taking direct damage, she consumes 6 stacks to dodge the damage
 II Valencina's this-turn Swiftness had too many bugs, so removed
9. So... does anyone remember this was supposed to be a command terminal?
10. New Card: Sixth Sense [code: sixthSense] (1): Gain some Dodge and Agility
11. New Card: Lobotomy Corp E.G.O::Magic Bullet [code: EGOMagicBullet] (0)

v0.2b Small Update
Fixed known bugs/Adjustments:
1. Fixed infinite loop bug with Combo Shoot and Disposal (which calls Combo Shoot)
2. Rein's Sinking was too high, stacking could cause player to be Staggered every turn, so nerfed (definitely not because I died to it)
3. Fixed Magic Bullet not consuming ammo and the 7th shot - Despair causing recursive self-KO
4. New card: Mad Snake (Fatal Chaos) [code: Si] (2): Repeats attacks based on Poise strength, at least 3 times; each attack applies Rapture strength and count, then applies poison based on them
5. @All Black Beasts, reply with skill 3 can now generate Mad Snake (Fatal Chaos). This is a sidegrade (?) – Rapture team, rise up!
6. Compared to Open the Way, "Move aside, I'll do it myself" felt a bit weak, so buffed its damage and added the new-era card replay feature
7. Rein got some floating text like "Dream of No-Self". I really put the most effort into Rein, but still needs polish – one person's power really isn't enough
8. Preparing to make Kromer / Kromer Aspiring to the Original. Mechanics preview:
 I Kromer applies lots of Bleed, and when using Purify, re-rolls this skill based on target's Bleed, no upper limit
 II Kromer also uses Mysterious Whistle to weaken the player and buff herself for the battle, but Mysterious Whistle doesn't apply Bleed count. If...?
9. Preparing to make GOD
 I GOD reduces own Sanity through basic skills
 II When GOD is attacked, applies Sinking to self
 III When GOD's Sanity drops to -45, nothing bad should happen... right? (holding back laughter)

v0.3 Update
Fixed bugs/Adjustments:
1. I wonder why I'm writing code while listening to Yesod and Hod's core suppression music
2. Hod's core suppression music is really upbeat, but after listening, I can't type anymore
3. Anyway, the plans are partially complete. Our Umbrella God's logic is fully written, as follows:
 I On being attacked, gain {0}0% damage reduction based on own Sinking count, capped at 50%
 II On being attacked, gain +1 Sinking count and +1 Sinking strength, and Umbrella God's skills apply lots of self-Sinking
 III The rest of the mechanics are negligible. In short, Umbrella God is a pure punching bag, trust me
4. Kromer is still waiting; too lazy to do her
5. Fixed bug where Set Danger Level input hint was "Grace"
6. Reminder: The following actions will erase your save data:
 I "Erase you, erase me" in Settings
 II Entering /kill in Settings cheat code
 III Delete and reinstall this app
7. Some fun cards and their codes, obtainable with the getCard cheat code:
 1. cogito is the code for Cogito. Cogito is a very fun card – try a deck with only 2 Cogitos and see what happens
 2. WordPower_Death is the code for Word of Death. You can't still not know how to get the instant-kill card, right?
 3. @AllHeiShou is the code for @All Black Beasts, reply with skill 3. More types of Black Beasts will be summonable in the future
 4. setDanger is the code for Set Danger Level. You can use it to set danger level. Who doesn't know this card?
 5. After entering getCard in the cheat code, a popup will ask for the card code. Note: codes are case-sensitive

v0.3.1 Emergency Fix
Fixed bugs/Adjustments:
1. Due to a spawn logic bug, the new enemy Umbrella God essentially became a punching bag
 How to get 4 from randint(1,3)
2. "Move aside, I'll do it myself" accidentally caused an infinite loop; fixed now
3. Since this is an emergency fix, no other content

v0.4 Update
Fixed bugs/Adjustments:
1. Overhauled locked health code; Rein now has locked health
2. Rein gained 2 phase-transition locked health
3. Umbrella God's HP reduced from 20,000 to 10,000, but passive Rain of Tears damage reduction cap increased from 50% to 90%, and gained 1 locked health
4. Fixed issue where both sides would sit idle for 3 turns after locked health trigger due to Stagger
5. New enemy added: Kromer
6. Due to some enemies (Umbrella God and Valencina) having strong defense, Word of Death was a bit weak, so buffed
7. Fixed a lot of locked health related bugs
8. Fixed Kromer repeatedly triggering phase-transition locked health bug (lore accurate)

v0.5 Music Update
Adjustments:
1. Originally planned to make the three adorable birds' cards first, but figured it's time for music, so did that
2. This is really a big update – 5 Activities and 1 Store all revamped
3. You can now adjust volume in Settings!
4. Currently only battle has its own music, borrowed from Lobotomy Corp of course
5. Now our most important screen (maybe not) has its own unique music: The Index's anthem, Children Of The City!!!
6. Oh wow, Purify is so nasty – it dispels locked health! I fixed that (definitely not because it prevented people from hearing Kromer's phase 2 music that I painstakingly bound)
7. Some special enemies now have mysterious music
8. The three birds are finally done. I'm exhausted, exhausted, exhausted
9. A new wheelchair has arrived, along with the highest-cost card: Big Monster. Its attributes are random, just like Proliferating G

v0.6 Update
Adjustments/Fixes
1. Fixed the Rapture detonation logic of "Believe in the Martial Soul"
2. Streamlined Big Monster's DOT application logic
3. Streamlined Proliferating G's DOT application logic to prevent some freezes
4. "No Rhythm" and "Invincible!" now go to hand rather than being played directly
5. Fixed incorrect monster spawn logic
6. <Below are updates for v0.6.1> Added a large amount of English translations, though some still need improvement
7. Also added Bloodstained Tears as a finisher for Rapture teams
8. So tired, so tired; tried to fix the delay in Kromer's music transition...
